actual_source_material.stage_credibility: The project author supplies captions linking early, draft, alternative, chosen and final. Files verified, but only browser preview of draft, not exhaustive independent high-res eye-inspection of every file.

secondary_creator.author: 张家佳

true_authored_actions.source: 梁志坚 放肆喜欢 喜 的最终版本
true_authored_actions.observed_fact: Author explicitly narrates reducing excess strokes within dense 喜: opening breaks at the top horizontal, adjusting central negative space, dropping lower bars of the two 口 components and merging dots/horizontal into one coherent feature shape. The goal is to preserve recognizability while matching word-wide graphic ink weight.
true_authored_actions.what_it_is_NOT: Not global x-scale, taper, endpoint width, a font stroke table, texture overlay or exact geometry recovered from GIF.
true_authored_actions.trigger: One glyph in multi-character wordmark is much denser than its neighbors AND exposes truly redundant/mergeable components that remain readable after edit.
operations: Evaluate full phrase and flag the densest outlier BEFORE altering path geometry.
Propose topology-level merge/open/delete candidates for repetitive structural strokes in that outlier.
Verify target character remains unambiguously correct at thumbnail size and not confused with a different Hanzi.
Recheck the word as a whole: optical mass, open counters, main/secondary gestures; if character recognition breaks, revert.
reject_when: Changes make text wrong or unreadable
Stronger letter no longer matches rest of word

true_authored_actions.observed_fact: Author states 上 is structurally sparse and 座 dense, so equal side-by-side character boxes leave unbalanced spaces; explores vertically connected, integrated lettering composition, then redesigns the stroke language at whole-mark level.
true_authored_actions.what_it_is_NOT: Not simply scaling individual left/right radicals or copying the image as vectors in Figma.
true_authored_actions.trigger: Two-character wordmark with radically unequal density; equal cell presentation looks optically imbalanced despite correct literal glyphs.
operations: First compare standard horizontal and compact vertical arrangement as alternative COMPOSITION TOPOLOGIES.
Let the sparse glyph's open space and dense glyph's occupied region inform shared flow rather than forcibly equalizing stroke thickness.
Draw coherent major gesture across both forms while preserving two separate legible character identities.
Reject any composition that breaks read order, exact characters, or weight distribution.

limitations: Original author chose final forms in context of specific words, not universal template for other glyphs.
Image dimensions/hashes confirm access, not subjective design excellence.
Some browser image previews are partial; do not pretend detailed tracing or pen trajectory was reconstructed.
No human reviewer of new styled text and no heldout styled text was generated.
No 105 independent image studies; animation frames are ONE artwork's process media.

selected_next_test.reason: Source documents choosing a different whole-word layout, a qualitatively different action than R1–R9 geometric glyph tweaks; strong control case available.
selected_next_test.native_generation_budget: same no-added-fee methods, one output per arm only when uncontrollable tool interface behaves
selected_next_test.next_true_gate: Write two comparable independent layouts of entirely new wordmark; render and inspect outputs; admit method only on actual human preference without cherry-picked repeats.
selected_next_test.caution: This is a design-brief hypothesis; do NOT mechanically render typography as A/B geometry and call it designer skill.
